notes.title: Playtest is coming!
notes.content:
Are you excited for the game Die Last ? [b]Playtest is right around the corner![/b] 💥

notes.title: Earth is our only home 🫂💚
notes.content:
🌎 Do you realize that the entire economy of the #DieLast revolves around Carbon and Biodiversity credits? Each denotes an action taken to preserve and regenerate our natural world, the planet Earth 🙌.

What do the game and the real world have in common? That's a separate story; we'll tell it in future announcements. As for now, we've prepared some tips on how you can help our planet to regenerate:

🌱 Reduce, Reuse, Recycle: practice the 3 R's to minimize waste and conserve resources.

🌱 Conserve water: turn off faucets when not in use, fix leaks promptly, and consider installing water-saving devices.

🌱 Use energy wisely: turn off lights and appliances when not in use, switch to energy-efficient bulbs, and unplug electronics when not in use.

🌱 Planting trees: they absorb carbon dioxide and provide oxygen, helping to combat climate change.

🌱 Minimize single-use plastics: say no to single-use plastics like straws, bags, and bottles whenever possible.

🌱 Educate yourself and others: stay informed about environmental issues and spread awareness to inspire positive change in your community.

Earth is our only home, and we should do everything to protect it! 🫂💚

notes.title: Let's dive back into exploring the benefits of lost objects!
notes.content:
When you reunite lost items in #DieLast, you unlock incredible effects, like this one:

notes.title: 🛜 We have some interesting facts to share with you about the Die Last game.
notes.content:
Did you know players can attack enemies' pipes to steal karma using DeBots? 

Players can send stolen karma from enemies' forests to their own using pipes, so much karma exchange is happening. ⚙️

notes.title: 🔍 Time to delve again into the mysteries of Lost Objects in Die Last!
notes.content:
When you discover and combine these items, they offer effects like: 
 
⏸️ Pacifism: Your DeBot army takes a timeout from combat for a specific time. 
 
🔋 Disarm: The Block Keeper or DeBot army goes offline and cannot receive commands for a specific time.

notes.title: 🤔 Are you curious why you should build pipes in Die Last?
notes.content:
These pipes transport valuable Karma. Connect Pipes to a Forest or a Factory, and you unlock new realms of exploration, venturing into uncharted territories. 🏭

Wherever your journey takes you, your network of pipes will faithfully transport your DeBots. 🤖

notes.title: 🎉 Delve into exciting discovery about the new effect of Lost Object
notes.content:
🌀 Watch spatial orientation become a distant memory in the effects of Drunkenness: watch as the Block Keeper loses spatial orientation, stumbling and moving to different cells than they commanded move to. 
 
This unpredictable twist adds a new layer of excitement and challenge to your gameplay experience.

notes.title: 🤖 Who is DeBot
notes.content:
🤖 In groundbreaking Die Last game, your DeBots are not just tools; they are your key to survival and success. DeBots have unique traits for building pipes and planting trees, protecting or engaging in strategic gameplay, and the thrilling pursuit of stealing rival players' karma.
 
🔔 But even the mightiest DeBots need enough karma to serve you. So before you launch an attack, plant enough trees to support it — it's the key to success on the battlefield.

notes.title: 🔮 Unveil one more effect of Lost Objects
notes.content:
Get ready for more surprises in Die Last as we unveil one more effect of Lost Objects.

Discover the disruptive impact of Builder's Rebellion: the DeBots unsettle the equilibrium by randomly choosing targets and damaging allied pipes across the map. Prepare for potential chaos lasting for a few hours!

Are you up for the challenge? 💥

notes.title: 🌀 Why does karma play a fundamental role in Die Last?
notes.content:
Trees symbolize [b]the essence of life[/b]. In the game, life is represented as [b]karma[/b] - a unit that quantifies every action and enables each move to be executed. 🌳

Everything costs karma. It's what makes you stronger in this post-industrial world. You can't buy it, but you can get it for planting trees, reviving the ground that turned vile after the old order poisoned it.

💪 The larger your forest, the more karma you will receive. You can even claim your opponent's forest if you've accumulated enough karma.

notes.content:
🌲 Discover various lost objects scattered throughout the area, fuse them, and unlock fantastic effects like [b]I LOVE TREES[/b].

🌿 [i]This effect is about gaining the ability to whimsically plant various trees in unexpected spots for an hour![/i]

✅ If you like the game and want to be notified when it's released, please tap the [b]Add to your Wishlist[/b] button.

notes.title: 🌱 Why do players need to plant trees in Die Last?
notes.content:
🌎 They breathe life into the world and revive the ground that turned vile after the old order poisoned it. But there's something else - [b]trees are a giver of life[/b]. In the game, life is called [b]Karma[/b], the unit by which every action is measured.

🌳 By cultivating your Forest, you witness the expansion of your woodland domain and your Karma rewards. The larger your Forest, the more Karma you will receive, [b]the more this world comes alive![/b]

notes.title: Die Last by GOSH
notes.content:
Hello everyone, and welcome to the world of Die Last.

Die Last is a lovingly crafted MMORTS game developed by a small indie studio. The world-renowned Hayao Miyazaki and Studio Ghibli inspire its art stylistics.

[quote=Hayao Miyazaki] [i]"The creation of a single world comes from a huge number of fragments and chaos."
Hayao Miyazaki[/i] [/quote] 

It is focused entirely on [b]regeneration[/b], which involves imbuing a decaying landscape with new life. Players regenerate the ecosystem of a rotten world through teamwork, subterfuge, cunning, and strategy.

The entire economy of Die Last revolves around [b]Carbon and Biodiversity ideas[/b], each denoting an action taken to preserve and [b]regenerate our real world[/b], the planet Earth, just as the players revitalize the world inside the game. We'll reveal this in detail in future announcements.

You're also warm-welcomed on our Discord and Twitter. Connect with soulmate pals and participate in contests to secure [b]Steam gifts and other valuable rewards.[/b]

🤖 https://twitter.com/playdielast

🐦 https://discord.gg/dielast


🌳 Let's revive this post-industrial world together!
